title: M Scenes
description: Choreographed interior ambient light scenes. Welcome lights the cabin corner to corner when a door opens; M Mode runs the M tricolour (blue -> dark blue -> red) chasing the dash on each side; Celebration sweeps rainbow waves across every zone for half a minute; Sunset fades from warm amber under the dash up to cool magenta on the roof; Night Drive settles on a dim, warm backlight. Each scene drives every lit zone the car has (dash, doors, footwell, console, seats, roof) through the BDC's workshop jobs INNENLICHT_FI_LIN_1_LAYERING / _LIN_2_LAYERING. Nothing is persisted on the car's own coding - every write lasts at most 254 s and the car takes over again by itself. Needs the Light tool (the Store installs it with the app).

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._notes: Welcome scene listens to door events and ignition state; Night Drive looks at ambient light for auto-dim
